front.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: closed-eye blink texture patch for a 2D illustrated character rig.
Input image 1 is the ONLY edit target: the original front-facing anime full-color head-and-neck crop, 850 x 1200 pixels.
Primary request: Change ONLY BOTH EYES to naturally closed eyes. Remove the visible irises, whites, and open-eye contours and replace them with skin matching the exact adjacent complexion plus thin dark softly curved closed upper eyelashes at natural eyelid positions. Make a calm blink, with no other expression change.
Composition/framing: Preserve the EXACT original 850 x 1200 crop framing and position of every feature. Keep face silhouette, face proportions, head size, gaze-axis/pose, hat, ribbon, bangs, every hair strand, neck, clothing, blush, skin tones, shadows, nose, and mouth EXACTLY unchanged. Do not redraw the illustration or alter the art style. Keep the bangs in front of and partly obscuring the eyes exactly as in the input.
Background: Actual transparent background with a real alpha channel, matching the existing transparency. Do not draw a checkerboard, white, black, gray, or colored background.
Constraints: This is a precision edit to two small eye regions only, intended for extracting masked patches, so alignment is critical. No new artistic redesign, no face reshaping, no smile, no text, no watermark.
front.qa: Both eyes closed; full-frame proportions appear closely preserved at proportional scale. Generated image has a baked checkerboard background despite alpha request. Use only masked eye interiors; do not composite full generated crop.
